reason: A cross-session memory vault that persistently stores agent facts and preferences, recalls them through model tools, injects recent entries into prompts, and provides a browser management page.

summaries.zh: 跨会话记忆插件，用于持久化保存、检索和删除智能体记忆，并将近期条目注入每轮提示上下文。
summaries.en: A cross-session memory plugin that stores, retrieves, and deletes agent memories while injecting recent entries into each prompt context.

capabilities: Provides remember, recall, and forget tools
Injects recent stored entries into each system-prompt assembly
Provides a browser page to browse, add, and delete memory entries
